children: Manufacturing activity in the Richmond Fed's region edged down this month, the reserve bank's monthly survey showed.
The survey's composite index was minus 2 in September, dropping from 4 in August. Economists polled by The Wall Street Journal expected the reading to hold flat at 4.
Two of its three component indexes, shipments and new orders, pulled back into negative territory. The index for employment meanwhile jumped, flipping back into positive territory.
The local business conditions index also dropped into negative territory, and the index for future local business conditions continued to fall.
The average growth of prices paid jumped notably, while prices received ticked up more moderately, according to the survey.
Firms surveyed are located within the Fifth Federal Reserve District, which includes the District of Columbia, Maryland, North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia and most of West Virginia.
